Learning objectives & teacher notes

Level 1 covers main-group atoms with full notation and orbital boxes. Level 2 adds main-group ions and abbreviated notation. Level 3 is cumulative and includes d-block atoms and ions, all representations, and assessed isoelectronic matching.

Ground-state configurations, Cr/Cu exceptions, 4s-before-3d ionisation, orbital capacities, Hund's rule, and equivalent orbital permutations use the checked OCR A Level chemistry bank.

Curriculum: OCR A Level Chemistry A H432, 2.2.1(b–d) and 5.3.1(a). Sources and validation conventions remain in the activity README.
